experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Join an open-air sunrise yoga session overlooking the lush Campuhan valley, followed by a peaceful walk along the ridge trail. The cool morning air and stunning green landscape make this a deeply restorative experience. On rainy days, many local studios in Ubud offer indoor classes with the same instructors.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset Session
experiences.description: Spend the late afternoon on the golden sands of Seminyak Beach, one of Bali's most beautiful stretches of coastline. Swim, relax, or join a beachside yoga flow class offered by local instructors near the shore. The famous Bali sunset here is spectacular. Arrive by 5 PM to avoid midday heat and catch the golden hour.

experiences.name: Traditional Balinese Cooking Class
experiences.description: Learn to prepare authentic Balinese dishes such as nasi goreng, satay lilit, and lawar in a shaded open-air kitchen or fully indoor studio. Classes typically begin with a morning market visit to source fresh local ingredients. A perfect midday indoor alternative that combines culture and food in a cool, engaging environment.

experiences.name: Tirta Empul Temple Purification Ritual
experiences.description: Visit the sacred Tirta Empul water temple and participate in a traditional Balinese purification ceremony in the holy spring pools. A local guide will explain the spiritual significance and proper etiquette. Visit early morning to avoid crowds and heat. On overcast days the experience is equally magical and the temple provides shaded areas throughout.

experiences.name: Stand-Up Paddleboarding at Sanur Beach
experiences.description: Enjoy a calm and beginner-friendly stand-up paddleboarding session on the sheltered waters of Sanur Beach. The reef-protected lagoon offers flat, gentle waves ideal for all skill levels. Morning sessions are best before the wind picks up. If weather turns, the area has excellent beachside cafes and a covered art market to explore indoors.
